name: translate
title: Translate
description: Translate, define, and speak text using the local translate CLI (multi-engine auto-fallback, offline dictionaries).
author: da-wei_lee

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate
commands.description: Translate text into a target language.

preferences.name: prefill
preferences.title: Prefill input from
preferences.description: When opening Translate, seed the input box from the current selection or the clipboard (empty when there is nothing to grab, so you can also just type). Defaults to Nothing — use Translate Selection to act on the selection/clipboard.

commands.name: translate-selection
commands.title: Translate Selection
commands.description: Open Translate prefilled with the selected (or clipboard) text.

commands.name: translate-text
commands.title: Translate Text
commands.description: Translate a long passage in a multi-line box (no search-bar length limit).

commands.name: look-up-word
commands.title: Look up Word
commands.description: Search dictionary headwords, browse recent lookups, and open a full definition page.

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: translate binary path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the translate CLI. Empty = auto-probe ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/go/bin.

preferences.name: defaultTarget
preferences.title: Default target language
preferences.description: Language code (e.g. en, zh-TW, ja). Leave empty to inherit the translate config's default_target.

preferences.name: engine
preferences.title: Engine
preferences.description: Engine override: auto, google, dict, or a provider name. Empty = CLI default.

preferences.name: tier
preferences.title: Model tier
preferences.description: LLM model tier. "Use config default" inherits the translate config's tier.

preferences.name: liveDebounceMs
preferences.title: Live translate debounce (ms)
preferences.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before translating (min 250). Leave empty to inherit the translate config's debounce_ms (falls back to 700).
